title: 7-Year Treasury Note auction (November new issue) — the last coupon sale of the year's most compressed macro session
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23 initial-research adjacency sweep. Row reads verbatim `7-Year NOTE Thursday, November 19, 2026 Wednesday, November 25, 2026 Monday, November 30, 2026` with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and a lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-11-19 announcement itself. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23 initial-research adjacency sweep, which found it at D+2 inside the 5-day corridor and untracked. It sells off the SAME 11-19 announcement as the proposing 2Y and settles the SAME day (11-30). The sibling proposal proposals/treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-19.from-treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.json (2026-09-08) declined to file this leg separately; the reasoning for differing — the October block already carries treasury-7y-note-2026-10-29 as its own canonical file, and the 11-12 refunding-leg precedent it cites is a different structure — is written out in full in the sibling 5Y proposal of this same sweep. WHY THIS ONE IS NOT AN ORDINARY 7Y SLOT, and the reason it earns a row rather than a mention: it is the only coupon auction this calendar tracks that prices into a session already carrying FIVE tracked macro releases — pce-2026-11-25, gdp-q3-2026-second-2026-11-25, durable-goods-2026-11-25, new-home-sales-2026-11-25 and beige-book-2026-11-25 — because Thanksgiving (Thursday 11-26, a full closure) pulls the normal Thursday/Friday release slate forward onto the Wednesday. Whoever researches it inherits the same identification problem treasury-20y-bond-2026-11-18 documented for the FOMC-minutes collision, only worse: grade the auction on its own statistics (bid-to-cover, composition, tail), never on the day's close-to-close move. SIZE IS UNPUBLISHED TODAY: `sb0590` (2026-08-05, read direct 2026-09-09) publishes anticipated coupon sizes only through `Oct-26`, where the 7-Year column reads 44; the November grid arrives at the 2026-11-04 refunding.
